name: Serpentbloom
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Serpentbloom has drawn the Royal Apothecary Society’s keen interest for its potent natural properties.

sections.title: A Rare Subterranean Flora
sections.body:
In the Barrens, Serpentbloom thrives in the shadowy, damp tunnels of the Wailing Caverns. Unrestrained Emerald Dream energies have warped the caverns’ ecosystem. Venomous serpents often nest among the herb’s stems.

Hostile beasts and corrupted druids overrun the caves. Few who venture inside return with viable specimens.

sections.title: Apothecary Interest
sections.body:
At the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah gathers Serpentbloom for the Royal Apothecary Society in Undercity. The Forsaken seek virulent, strange, chemically potent plants across Kalimdor to fuel research for the Dark Lady.

Zamah believes a harvest of Serpentbloom in significant quantities could bring valuable breakthroughs in Forsaken alchemy.

faq.answer: Serpentbloom grows only deep inside the Wailing Caverns, a labyrinthine network southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. It clings to the ground in the cavern’s dark, damp recesses.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want Serpentbloom?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah, an agent of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Thunder Bluff, seeks Serpentbloom for research. The Forsaken study unusual and dangerous flora across Kalimdor to develop new chemical concoctions and advance the Society’s broader goals in service to Sylvanas Windrunner.
The Wailing Caverns crawl with raptors, crocolisks, and corrupted druids. Serpentbloom often shelters venomous snakes, which may strike when the herb is disturbed.

faq.q: Can herbalists find Serpentbloom more easily?
faq.answer: Yes. Herbalists are naturally attuned to spotting vegetation, and can track Serpentbloom patches in the cavern’s shadowy corners.

angles.text: As an undead, gathering Serpentbloom aids Apothecary Zamah and the Royal Apothecary Society as they seek botanical assets in foreign lands to strengthen the Forsaken.
As a herbalist, your trained eye can find rare cavern blooms where others see only damp stone.
